explication: WorldWideView is a plugin-driven geospatial situational-awareness platform. Its primary workflow discovers live data engines, connects enabled plugins to their streams, distributes updates through the DataBus, stores application state, and renders entities on a Cesium globe. Separate capabilities cover plugin marketplace management, alerts, MCP/agent control, and camera viewing. The README documents the main data-to-globe flow; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX support selected internal calls. Some listed subsystems were not sampled, so their internal links are omitted.
